finding.text: `Plugin.store` and `Plugin.hosts` no longer cover Page. `store` and `hosts` are statics inside the mixin, so every `Pluggable(...)` call makes its own copy (Plugin.js diff, `this.store.get`, `this.hosts.push`). `core/Plugin/page.js:6,151` still sets `Plugin.store = local` and lists `Plugin.hosts`, so Page's on/off state is never saved to localStorage and Page never shows on the Plugin page. Page.plugins' "class-wide off, per-page on" state is real but invisible there. Share one store and one hosts list across hosts (read them from `Plugin`), or say in the readme that each host has its own.

`core/Plugin/doc/design-notes.md` is stale: line 22 says `Page.use(Ext)` "is left alone… has no off switch… moving Page onto Plugin is a follow-up", and line 31 says "`Page.use` is not migrated". `core/Page/doc/classes.md:23,43` still says `class Page extends Item`. Neither file is in the diff.

`core/Page/ext/Inbox/Inbox.js:129` and `:144` were not touched. The requirement said to fix them "if they become wrong". They are still roughly true, but they say "calling this" and name no plugin path. Add one line saying the call comes from `Pluggable`, or note in the task log that you checked and left them.

The task folder can't be continued from alone. `shots/` holds only Chrome "This site can't be reached" pages (`layout.json` has `widest_text_sample` "This site can't be reached", `items 0`), because the review server was down. The `live-plan/fold-2` folder has no log of the name-collision overlap that requirement 2 asked for, and no before/after test counts file. The counts and the smoke result exist only as `log` lines in `session.jsonl`.

`Pluggable` brings static `on`/`off`/`once`/`clear`/`emit` onto Page. Requirement 2 said "brings none of those names". There is no collision with Item today, since Item has no static `on` or `emit`, but a future one would break. Item's statics were grepped; the grep was not logged.
The new `PluginsFixture` ext is indexed in `ext/readme.md` and `ext/page.jsonl`. That is correct, but it ships as a live site file that exists only for a test.
Class page for the new class: Page's live plugin instances are viewable through `Page.plugins`, but nothing opens a page that shows them. Say where to look.
